data.body: CROSS-EPIC DEPENDENCY NOTE from 69e8-af39-7886-4ee9: 69e8's /dso:fix-bug Phase G extension EXECUTES AFTER 4911's bug-type-<slug> classification step (explicit ordering — Phase G consumes the slug tag 4911 sets). When 4911 classification fails or is not yet present on a ticket being closed, 69e8 sets bug_type_slug='unclassified' and adds retro-needs-classification tag to surface in /dso:retro. 4911's classifier output (the bug-type-<slug> taxonomy) is consumed by 69e8 SC2/SC3/SC5.
